Mahesh Shamlal Nanvani vs The State Of Maharashtra on 9 May,
2019

Author: R. I. Chagla
Bench: R. I. Chagla

jsn
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Bail Application No. 1292 Of 2019
Mahesh Shamlal Nanvani ... Applicant
 V/s.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Vinod Sagvikar, i/b. Mr. Umesh Mankapure for the Applicant.
Mr. S.R. Agarkar, App for the State.

Coram: R. I. Chagla, J.
(Vacation Court) Date: 9Th May, 2019 Pc:-
1.
Heard the learned Counsel for the Applicant and the learned APP for the State.

The Applicant seeks release of the Applicant on regular bail in connection with C.R. No.74 of 2019 registered with Sangli City Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34 of the IPC and Section 26(2), 26(2) (4), 27 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 on the ground that the Applicant is suffering paralysis.
The Applicant has annexed medical certificate which shows that the Applicant has been diagnosed with MCA Infarct and Diabetes Mellitus.
The learned APP requires time verify the same and states that it would be necessary for the jail authorities to examine the Applicant.
The Application is accordingly adjourned to 16th May, 2019.

( R. I. CHAGLA, J. )
